method: For each complete regular-season league week, compare the actual scheduled opponent's score to the mean score of the other N-1 teams (exclude the manager's own score). Average the difference over observed fully paired weeks for the manager season. 2016 N=8, other seasons N=10.
caveats: 2020 and 2021 exclude incomplete week 14 across the league; 2026 is only Weeks 1–8; ESPN/Sleeper settings change, and opponent points exposure does not prove skill or causal schedule luck.
